whoItsFor: Developers and teams who want to build, run, and schedule AI agents without writing everything from scratch, either through the hosted AutoGPT Platform or by self-hosting. The README is mostly marketing for the hosted product, so the self-hosting path is aimed at developers who can provide their own infrastructure and model API keys.
useCases: Automate daily executive briefs from internal and external signals
Triage engineering incidents and surface a likely cause
Monitor sources and return structured reports when something changes
